_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 12h windows producing ±2 point moves over 7 days and ETF flows at zero, this is a coiled risk-off market where HOLD is the statistically honest call until the named breaker — ETF flows turning positive with VIX below 50 — arrives.
next_move.brains_agree: No — narrative leans bullish on accumulation pattern while analyst demands HOLD pending institutional flow reversal; judge sides with analyst on direction but corrects phase to Panic per score-band rule.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive (>30) and VIX drops below 50 with funding sustaining above 55
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC momentum_30d drops below 45 and fear_greed breaks below 20 with stablecoin growth stalling below 45
